# Thermomat joins TAMARYS

The Thermomat / HAIRL group at the University of the Basque Country (EHU)
has joined [**GDR TAMARYS**](/network/networks/tamarys.html), the CNRS research
group (*groupement de recherche*) on thermal radiation–matter interaction, materials for extreme
environments and high-temperature systems, coordinated by Benoît Rousseau
(CNRS, LTeN Nantes).

TAMARYS links French laboratories and industrial partners around problems where
radiation decides the outcome, from decarbonising high-temperature processes to
reusable thermal protection for spacecraft. Emissivity, the property the
Thermomat group measures and curates in the [EKHI database](/data/ekhi.html),
sits at the centre of that agenda.

The group's contact in the network is **Iñigo González de Arrieta**. Members of
the group attended the network's thematic school on
[radiative transfer in semi-transparent media](/events-news/schools/2026-rtstm-hendaye.html)
in Hendaye in October.

This site now lists TAMARYS, PaRaMetriC and the IR-EMPOWER series in a new
[**Research networks & consortia**](/network/index.html#research-networks)
section of the research map.

*Emissivity.org Editorial Board · 17 October 2026.*
:::
